result.summary: The page is generally usable, but several horizontally scrolling elements are clipped at the viewport edges, making content look truncated. There are also minor contrast/readability concerns in secondary text.

issues.description: The right-side category chip after “Healthy” is cut off at the screen edge, and the “Fastest near you” carousel card/text (“Trattoria Piccol…”) is visibly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add clear horizontal scroll affordance, edge fade, or adjust card widths/padding so partially visible items look intentional and titles remain readable.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is cropped by the bottom of the viewport, showing only the top portion above the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom padding above the fixed tab bar or ensure the list can scroll far enough to reveal the full card.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time/details use small gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size and/or darken gray text to meet WCAG contrast guidance.

issues.description: The search placeholder text is light gray on a light gray field, which may appear washed out.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken the placeholder or field background while keeping placeholder visually distinct from entered text.
